definition.name: Pairing phase C - explicit credentials and scoped endpoints

nodes.label: Shared credential metadata and errors
nodes.task_summary: Implement compatible credential metadata and shared IPC types
nodes.prompt: ONE GOAL: Establish the shared credential API required by R8/R9. DELIVERABLE: tested code plus .omo/pairing-20260910/reports/c-contract.md specifying the exact exported API. SCOPE: erd-app/src/pairing.rs, erd-app/src/lib.rs, one shared connection-error module if needed, associated app tests, and strictly mechanical erd_app::PairingRecord literal initialization updates across dependent Rust callers/fixtures. Do NOT modify erd_host::PairingRecord, identity selection, UI, net discovery, or lifecycle. Implement PairingEndpoint, backward-compatible optional client endpoint metadata, shared key-free PairingSummary, exact-ID/key-matched metadata-only update that does not recreate missing records, and typed IpcError code/stage data per phase-c-contract.md. Preserve key/date encodings, array schema and Keychain service. Do not introduce mandatory disk access/persistence into one-off ClientSession explicit-PSK connections. Provide constructors/conversions needed by callers, with no speculative abstraction or extra database. Tests must demonstrate legacy record readability, metadata roundtrip/dedup, preservation of credentials, missing-record no resurrection, ID/key mismatch no mutation, and key-free summary/error serialization (machine fields, not prose). Run actual related app pairing/error tests and compile affected consumers on Omarchy. Do not run unrelated shell hosting tests. Stop when shared API and fixtures compile, meaningful RED/GREEN is captured, and c-contract.md is ready for dependent nodes. Work in /Volumes/T9-Mac/project/EclipticRD-Rewrite. nodes.label: R8 explicit desktop credentials
nodes.task_summary: Implement explicit saved-credential selection and desktop reconnect
nodes.prompt: ONE GOAL: Implement R8 desktop explicit credential selection and integrate existing R11 client regressions. DELIVERABLE: tested code, scoped browser evidence and .omo/pairing-20260910/reports/c-desktop.md. First read c-contract.md and c-ipv6.md for actual APIs. SCOPE: tauri-shell/src-tauri/src/lib.rs identity/list/connection command regions, pairing/discovery tests, and tauri-shell UI connection/credential selection files and their tests. Preserve unrelated host management, performance/input and visual improvements. Add flat optional pairing_id / JS pairingId. Without explicit PIN, load exactly selected ID; absent/missing ID errors before transport. Remove host/name/prefix/discovered-name credential inference. Discovery remains untrusted; keep identical-name distinct endpoints and do not inherit trust through dedup. Present saved credential selection separately and use key-free shared summaries. Persist endpoint after successful stored/new pairing auth via shared metadata API without replacing keys or resurrecting forgotten records; clean up any provisional session on persistence failure. Return structured errors mapped from typed sources, preserving original failure and R3 incompatibility. Integrate the uncommitted authenticate_client_session extraction/R11 tests; update them to pass explicit saved IDs without weakening fallback/error guarantees. Existing tests expecting unsafe name-based trust must become stronger R8 coverage, not be deleted. Add real localhost TLS stored-ID reconnect across store/recreated-session boundary plus wrong-ID/no-network and same-name regressions. Run related remote pairing/discovery tests and actual Bun discovery/connection tests once reliably. Render and inspect changed UI through the existing page harness; label mocked backend evidence honestly. Do not launch the unsafe concurrent real hosting path. nodes.label: R9 explicit iOS saved reconnect
nodes.task_summary: Implement PIN-free explicit iOS credential and Keychain reconnect
nodes.prompt: ONE GOAL: Implement R9 iOS explicit saved-credential reconnect. DELIVERABLE: tested native/UI code, scoped evidence and .omo/pairing-20260910/reports/c-ios.md. Read c-contract.md and c-ipv6.md for actual APIs first. SCOPE: ios-shell/src/commands.rs, state.rs, lib.rs registration/re-exports as necessary, associated tests, and ios-shell UI connection/discovery/credential selection files/tests. Do not alter desktop, core metadata, discovery or separate lifecycle implementation. Keep lifecycle_lock and existing connect_async ownership; do not remove serialization. Add flat pairing_id / pairingId, a key-free list_pairings command, exact-ID Keychain lookup without find_by_host fallback, successful endpoint persistence through the shared API, and typed IPC errors. UI must support saved-ID mode without PIN, fresh pairing with explicit PIN, and preserve scoped host/ports. Same-name discovery cannot choose credentials. Preserve Keychain service and legacy keys. Prove missing/unknown IDs cause no transport/bootstrap, correct stored ID is used, metadata survives reload, and no secret fields enter JS. Cover UI saved-mode click -> actual invoke argument, not validator-only assertions. Use supported related remote Rust tests and Bun iOS discovery/connection tests; compile actual physical-iOS target on Mac only if provisioning permits, with no simulators and no host-Mac Rust fallback.
